#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int nbInsert = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ) {
        char current = s[i];
        int count = 0;
        while (i < s.length() && s[i] == current) {
            count++;
            i++;
        }
        if (count % 2 == 0) {
            nbInsert++;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << nbInsert << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
